description: Apex dependency updates. Every input is pinned: actions by commit SHA, container images by digest, release binaries by SHA-256, crates by Cargo.lock.

packageRules.description: Rust crates: minor and patch updates in one PR, once a week.
GitHub Actions: full commit SHAs with the version as a comment, once a week.
Container images are always referenced by digest.
Fedora images never jump to the next release; major upgrades follow the manual runbook (ADR 0008).

Fedora 45 image digests (ARG BASE and ARG REPOS_BASE in image/Containerfile, and the CI containers) move together, daily, with no release-age wait: Fedora is the trusted root and rebuilds these tags daily. The pins live on registry.fedoraproject.org, which keeps old digests.

image/Containerfile is updated only by the custom managers for ARG BASE and ARG REPOS_BASE below. The Dockerfile manager would try to rewrite FROM lines built from ARGs (FROM ${BASE}, FROM ${REPOS_BASE}), so it stays off for this file.
Pinned release binaries in .github/scripts/install-tool.sh: version and SHA-256 move together.

customManagers.description: ARG BASE=registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora-bootc@sha256:... in image/Containerfile (digest only; the tag it follows is 45).
ARG REPOS_BASE=registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora@sha256:... in image/Containerfile, the repos stage base (digest only; tag 45). A separate manager because the replacement template names the ARG.
VERSION and SHA256 pairs after a '# renovate:' comment in install-tool.sh.
